title: 🚨 THE CHURCH DOESN’T NEED MORE YOUNG PEOPLE WITH PLATFORMS.
paragraphs: 🚨 THE CHURCH DOESN’T NEED MORE YOUNG PEOPLE WITH PLATFORMS.
It needs young leaders with character strong enough to survive one.
That should challenge every parent, pastor, mentor, and Christian leader.
Because talent can put someone in front of people.
Charisma can attract attention.
A gifted speaker can build an audience.
But none of those things guarantee a leader who knows how to follow Jesus, handle Scripture faithfully, resist hidden sin, receive correction, and serve without applause.
And here’s the uncomfortable question:
Who is teaching the next generation how to do that?

HOW TO MENTOR YOUNG CHRISTIAN LEADERS
Raising Servants Who Follow Christ, Handle Scripture Faithfully, and Lead With Character
This isn't about creating your clone.
It isn't about teaching young Christians how to become famous.
It is about raising disciples who eventually make disciples.
Paul told Timothy:
“And what you have heard from me in the presence of many witnesses entrust to faithful men, who will be able to teach others also.” — 2 Timothy 2:2
That is multiplication.
Paul → Timothy → faithful believers → others.
🔥 INSIDE THIS BOOK, YOU'LL LEARN HOW TO:
• Recognize faithfulness before talent
• Mentor through relationship instead of information alone
• Teach young leaders to study Scripture for themselves
• Correct mistakes without crushing the person
• Give responsibility without abandoning accountability
• Confront the dangerous addiction to recognition
• Help emerging leaders fight hidden sin and private compromise
• Disciple them through failure instead of wasting it
• Protect their prayer life, family, character, and inner walk with Christ
• Help them discover their gifts without turning them into your clone
• Move them from being disciples to making disciples
• Know when it's time to release them into greater responsibility
And you'll receive practical mentoring questions and a framework you can begin using with emerging leaders.
⚔️ MOST PEOPLE WANT TALENTED LEADERS.
Few are willing to patiently develop faithful ones.
Most notice charisma.
Few examine character.
Most celebrate the platform.
Few ask what happens in private.
Most want followers.
Few intentionally raise disciple-makers.
Which kind of mentor will you become?
Because somewhere in the next generation may be a young believer who simply needs someone mature enough to say:
“Walk with me. Let's follow Jesus together.”
Not for recognition.
Not for a badge.
For the mission.
⚔️ THIS IS A DISCIPLE-MAKING MOVEMENT.
If you believe the next generation needs more than motivational Christianity…
If you believe young leaders need Scripture, character, repentance, prayer, courage, humility, and obedience…
If you want to help raise leaders who will still follow Jesus when nobody applauds…
Then help us move this message beyond your screen:
Don't merely build followers.
Raise disciple-makers.

⚔️ GOSPEL WARRIOR
Truth. Discipleship. Transformation.
